note: Every leaf carries a status of 'sourced', 'assumed' or 'unsourced'. Nothing in this file may be filled in from model memory - see docs/build-plan.md section 2.8. Values marked 'unsourced' are not yet used by the engine. Age Pension rates and thresholds change on 20 March and 20 September; the rates here are those current on 2026-09-09 and the next adjustment is 20 September 2026.

guaranteeRate.source: ATO - Key superannuation rates and thresholds, Table 21: Super guarantee percentage (period 1 July 2026 - 30 June 2027)

maximumContributionBaseAnnual.source: ATO - Key superannuation rates and thresholds, Table 23: Maximum contribution base from 1 July 2026 (2026-27). Payday Super moved this from a quarterly to an annual basis on 1 July 2026.

concessionalCap.source: ATO - Key superannuation rates and thresholds, Table 1.1: Concessional contributions caps (2026-27, all ages)

nonConcessionalCap.source: ATO - Key superannuation rates and thresholds, Table 4: Non-concessional contributions cap (2026-27). Nil if total super balance at 30 June of the prior year is at or above the general transfer balance cap.

carryForwardTotalSuperBalanceThreshold.source: ATO - Contributions caps, 'Unused concessional cap carry forward'. Unused concessional cap may be carried forward for 5 years where total super balance at 30 June of the prior year is under this threshold.

generalTransferBalanceCap.source: ATO - Key superannuation rates and thresholds, Table 26: General transfer balance cap (2026-27)

earningsTaxAccumulation.source: ATO - How SMSFs are taxed, 'Tax on income': a complying superannuation fund qualifies for a concessional tax rate of 15%.

earningsTaxPensionPhase.source: ATO - How SMSFs are taxed: investment income from assets supporting a retirement-phase income stream is exempt current pension income (ECPI) and is not taxed.

minimumDrawdownPercentByAge.source: ATO - Key superannuation rates and thresholds, Table 11: Minimum percentage factor for certain pensions and annuities, column '2023-24 onwards'. Indicative factors; precise amounts follow SIS Regulations 1994 pro-rating and rounding.

preservationAgeByDateOfBirth.source: ATO - Super withdrawal options, 'Preservation age based on date of birth'

minimumAge.source: ATO - Downsizer super contributions, 'Eligibility': aged 55 or older at the time the contribution is made.

capPerPerson.source: ATO - Downsizer super contributions, 'Contribution limit': up to $300,000 per eligible person; total downsizer contributions cannot exceed total sale proceeds.

minimumOwnershipYears.source: ATO - Downsizer super contributions, 'Eligibility': home owned by you and/or your spouse for 10 or more years before the sale.

contributionsTaxConcessional.source: ATO - How SMSFs are taxed, 'Determining if a contribution is assessable': concessional contributions (employer and salary-sacrifice) are taxed in the fund at 15%.

brackets.source: ATO - Tax rates - Australian resident, 'Resident tax rates 2026-27'. Excludes the Medicare levy.

medicareLevyRate.source: ATO - Tax rates - Australian resident: 'The above rates do not include the Medicare levy of 2%.'

medicareLevyLowIncomeThresholds.source: ATO - Medicare levy reduction for low-income earners, 'Table: Medicare levy thresholds for a single individual'. ASSUMED: these are the published 2025-26 thresholds applied to 2026-27, because the 2026-27 thresholds were not yet published on 2026-09-09; they are normally lifted each year, so this slightly overstates the levy. The 10% shade-in rate is not stated on the page but is implied by the thresholds: (35,013-28,011) x 10% = 700.20 = 2% x 35,013.

lowIncomeTaxOffset.source: ATO - Low income tax offset: $700 up to $37,500; $700 less 5c per $1 over $37,500 to $45,000; $325 less 1.5c per $1 over $45,000 to $66,667.

seniorsAndPensionersTaxOffset.source: ATO - Seniors and pensioners tax offset, 'Rates and rebate income thresholds for SAPTO'. Taper is 12.5c per $1 of rebate income above the shade-out threshold.

rateEffectiveDate.source: Services Australia - How much Age Pension you can get: 'The Department of Social Services adjusts these rates every 20 March and 20 September.' The rates below are those current on 2026-09-09, i.e. the 20 March 2026 adjustment. NOTE: the next adjustment is 20 September 2026.

eligibilityAge.source: Services Australia - Who can get Age Pension: 'Age Pension age is 67 years or older. There are no plans to change this.'

fortnightsPerYear.source: Rates are published per fortnight; 26 fortnights per year is the standard annualisation.

maxRateFortnight.source: Services Australia - How much Age Pension you can get, 'Normal rates' table (maximum rates per fortnight, before tax).

incomeTest.source: Services Australia - Income test for Age Pension, 'What the standard rules are' and 'What the cut-off points are'. Single: 50c per $1 over $226/fn. Couple: each person's pension reduces by 25c per $1 of combined income over $396/fn, i.e. 50c combined.

assetsTest.source: Services Australia - Assets test for Age Pension (limits page last updated 1 July 2026). Taper: DSS Social Security Guide 4.2.3 - from 1 January 2017 every $1,000 over the free area reduces the rate by $3 per fortnight (single or couple combined). Cross-check: (733,500-333,000)/1000*3 = $1,201.50/fn, matching the $1,200.90 maximum single rate.

deeming.source: Services Australia - Deeming, 'How we work out your deemed income': single, first $66,800 deemed at 1.25% and the remainder at 3.25%; couple with at least one pensioner, first $110,600 combined.

workBonus.source: Services Australia - How a Work Bonus works: '$300 credit added to your Work Bonus balance each fortnight. The maximum Work Bonus balance you can accrue is $11,800 credit.' Applies to employment income only, before the income test.

rentAssistance.source: Services Australia - How much Rent Assistance you can get, 'Rates when paid with income support payments and ABSTUDY'. 'For every $1 of rent you pay above this amount, you'll get 75c.' Updated 20 March and 20 September in line with CPI; these are the rates current on 2026-09-10. Cross-check: (447.34 - 154.80) x 0.75 = 219.41 against the published $219.40 maximum, and (526.54 - 250.80) x 0.75 = 206.81 against $206.80.

discountRate.source: ATO - CGT discount: reduce a capital gain by 50% if the asset was held at least 12 months and you are an Australian resident.

pendingChangeNote.value: The ATO CGT discount page carries a notice: 'Recent changes to capital gains tax (CGT) announced in the 2026-27 Federal Budget don't apply to Tax Time 2026.' The content of those changes has not been read or modelled. Re-check before relying on long-horizon CGT output.
pendingChangeNote.source: ATO - CGT discount page notice, read 2026-09-09.

arrangement.source: My Aged Care - Aged care home costs and fees. Two fee regimes coexist: the 1 July 2014 arrangements for people already in care, and the 1 November 2025 arrangements for new entrants. Anyone entering care from a plan starting in 2026 falls under the 1 November 2025 arrangements, which is what is modelled.

basicDailyFeePerDay.source: My Aged Care - 'The basic daily fee is set at 85% of the single person rate of the basic age pension... the maximum basic daily fee is $66.80 per day, or $24,382 per year.' Indexed 20 March and 20 September. Cross-check: 85% of the $1,100.30 fortnightly basic rate divided by 14 is $66.80.

basicDailyFeeShareOfBasicPension.source: My Aged Care - 'The basic daily fee is set at 85% of the single person rate of the basic age pension.'

hotellingContributionMaxPerDay.source: My Aged Care - hotelling contribution, means tested, 'up to a limit of the hotelling supplement, $22.15 per day'.

nonClinicalCareContributionMaxPerDay.source: My Aged Care - non-clinical care contribution (1 November 2025 arrangements), 'capped daily at $107.32 per day'.

nonClinicalCareLifetimeCap.source: My Aged Care - 'residents no longer have to pay the non-clinical care contribution once they reach $137,917.01 (indexed) in total contributions, or after 4 years of cumulative contributions - whichever comes first'.

nonClinicalCareMaxYears.source: My Aged Care - the four-year cumulative cap on the non-clinical care contribution.

meansTestedCareFee2014Arrangements.source: My Aged Care - 1 July 2014 arrangements, retained for reference only. Not applied by the engine, which models the 1 November 2025 arrangements.

fullGovernmentAccommodationSupportThresh.source: My Aged Care - 'If you have income below $35,521.20 and assets below $64,500.00, the Australian Government will pay your full accommodation costs.'

maximumPermissibleInterestRate.source: NOT FETCHED. The MPIR converts an agreed room price (RAD) into a daily accommodation payment. The Department's MPIR page and PDF both 404'd on 2026-09-09. The engine therefore takes the annual accommodation cost as a direct user input rather than deriving it from a room price at an unsourced rate.

premiumGrowthRate.source: Department of Health, Disability and Ageing - average annual price changes in private health insurance premiums, industry average, mean of the ten years 1 April 2017 to 1 April 2026. See data/au-phi-premium-changes.json for the full series. Every one of those years exceeded the 2.5% CPI assumption.

latestApprovedIncrease.source: Department of Health, Disability and Ageing - average premium increase approved from 1 April 2026.

asfaRetirementStandard.source: NOT FETCHED. superannuation.asn.au returned HTTP 403 to automated requests on 2026-09-09. The ASFA modest/comfortable benchmarks are a convenience for picking a starting spend and nothing in the engine depends on them.
